description: This file implements a string hash map in C, providing functions for creation, cloning, insertion, deletion, iteration, and JSON serialization/deserialization of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: stringHashMapCreate
methods.description: Creates a new string hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapDeepClone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of an existing string hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a string hash map and frees associated memory.

methods.name: stringHashMapClear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapPut
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map; fails if key exists.

methods.name: stringHashMapPutCopy
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map, copying the strings.

methods.name: stringHashMapGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.

methods.name: stringHashMapContains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: stringHashMapDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the map.

methods.name: stringHashMapCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the map.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorCreate
methods.description: Creates an iterator for the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorHasNext
methods.description: Checks if more items are available in the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorGetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next key-value pair from the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorDeleteCurrent
methods.description: Deletes the current item in the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapJSONSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the map to a JSON string.

methods.name: stringHashMapJSONDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a map.

methods.name: stringHashMapToJSON
methods.description: Converts a map to a cJSON object.

methods.name: stringHashMapFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a map from a cJSON object.
